hints.title: Suffix Strictly Increasing Property
hints.text: Any array formed by removing a prefix is a suffix of the original array.

hints.title: Backward Linear Scan
hints.text: Start from the last element and move backwards while nums[i - 1] < nums[i].

hints.title: Prefix Length
hints.text: Stop at the first violation index i where nums[i - 1] >= nums[i]. The minimal prefix removal length is i.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all prefixes takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects simple backwards scan stopping at the first non-increasing step.
